title.zh-CN: 咯血贫血与既往胰腺炎 · 14岁女孩
title.en: Haemoptysis, anaemia and pancreatitis history · girl aged 14

summary.zh-CN: 长期胸腹症状与血性引流并存，需区分肺出血证据和“特发性”病因标签。
summary.en: Chest/abdominal symptoms and bloody drainage require distinction between evidence of bleeding and an idiopathic label.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 整合血性引流、咯血和缺铁证据。
learningOutcomes.en: Integrate bloody drainage, haemoptysis and iron deficiency.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明含铁血黄素不能单独定因。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why haemosiderin does not independently establish cause.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 提出胰腺胸腔联系和继发病因复核。
learningOutcomes.en: Identify pancreatic-thoracic links and secondary causes for review.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 先评估严重贫血和持续出血，保留特发性诊断的排除边界
learningOutcomes.en: Assess severe anaemia and bleeding while retaining limits of an idiopathic diagnosis

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 上腹痛5个月、咯血4个多月、乏力2个月
chiefComplaint.en: Five months of upper abdominal pain, over four months of haemoptysis and two months of fatigue

triageNote.zh-CN: 反复咯血、头晕乏力，曾接受胰腺和肺部治疗。
triageNote.en: Recurrent haemoptysis, dizziness and fatigue after pancreatic and pulmonary treatment.

personality.en: Provides information from the current stage; conversational style is an educational convention.

speechStyle.en: Uses everyday language; numerical results come from the records.

question.en: When did abdominal pain begin, and how was it treated? What colour was the pancreatic drainage?

answer.zh-CN: 五个月前左上腹痛，胰腺引流出血性液体后缓解。

prompt.zh-CN: 哪些证据要求重新评估“肺脓肿”标签？
prompt.en: What evidence requires reassessing the lung-abscess label?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 反复血性表现和缺铁性贫血需评估肺出血及胸腹联系
text.en: Recurrent blood-stained findings and iron deficiency require pulmonary bleeding and thoracoabdominal assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 腔性影像不自动等于已确证细菌脓肿。
feedback.en: A cavity is not automatically a proven bacterial abscess.

text.zh-CN: 影像称脓腔即可不再查其他原因
text.en: An imaging abscess label ends the differential

feedback.zh-CN: 血性引流和反复贫血需要解释。
feedback.en: Bloody drainage and recurrent anaemia need explanation.

text.zh-CN: 只补铁即可忽略持续咯血
text.en: Iron replacement alone permits ignoring haemoptysis

feedback.zh-CN: 必须评估持续失血来源及风险。
feedback.en: Ongoing blood loss and risk need assessment.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 含铁血黄素支持既往出血，尚不能独自证明特发性或与胰腺炎因果关系
text.en: Haemosiderin supports prior bleeding but does not alone establish idiopathic disease or pancreatic causation

feedback.zh-CN: 胰腺胸腔并发症、感染及其他出血病因仍需专业复核。
feedback.en: Pancreatic thoracic complications, infection and other bleeding causes need review.

text.zh-CN: 两次阳性已排除所有继发病因
text.en: Two positive samples exclude all secondary causes

feedback.zh-CN: 该检测不能完成病因排除。
feedback.en: The test does not exclude every cause.

text.zh-CN: ANCA阴性排除所有肺血管炎
text.en: Negative ANCA excludes all pulmonary vasculitis

feedback.zh-CN: 需结合完整临床和其他证据。
feedback.en: Full clinical and other evidence is required.

prompt.zh-CN: 如何避免按历史诊断过早关闭鉴别？
prompt.en: How can premature closure on the historical diagnosis be avoided?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 呼吸、血液及消化团队评估出血稳定性、胰腺胸腔联系和免疫治疗风险
text.en: Respiratory, haematology and GI teams should assess bleeding stability, pancreatic-thoracic links and immunotherapy risks

feedback.zh-CN: 报告使用激素不等于感染等已被充分排除。
feedback.en: Reported steroids do not prove adequate exclusion of infection.

text.zh-CN: 照搬激素即可无需再评估感染
text.en: Copy steroids without further infection assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 感染未充分排除时可能增加风险。
feedback.en: Risk may increase if infection remains insufficiently excluded.

text.zh-CN: 宣布胰腺炎必然引起此肺病

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：整合血性引流、咯血和缺铁证据。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：肺活检、引流液淀粉酶、完整出血鉴别和治疗后转归。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Integrate bloody drainage, haemoptysis and iron deficiency. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Lung histology, fluid amylase, complete bleeding differential and treatment outcome. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 具有肺出血线索并胰腺炎，原报告“特发性”及亚型标签的证据有限。
conclusion.en: Pulmonary bleeding clues coexist with pancreatitis; evidence for the source’s idiopathic/subtype label is limited.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 提出胰腺胸腔联系和继发病因复核。
teachingPoints.en: Identify pancreatic-thoracic links and secondary causes for review.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 肺活检、引流液淀粉酶、完整出血鉴别和治疗后转归。
unknowns.en: Lung histology, fluid amylase, complete bleeding differential and treatment outcome.

references: 李建秋, 何庆南. 伴胰腺炎型特发性肺含铁血黄素沉着症1例. 中华实用儿科临床杂志. 2013;28(22):1755-1756. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.2095-428X.2013.22.023.

notice.zh-CN: 教学脚本评估，并非经过验证的能力评分。
notice.en: A teaching-script measure, not a validated competency score.

testUtterances.text: 腹痛是什么时候开始，做过什么处理？
